# Hadramout Research Center

> Bilingual (Arabic-first / English) website for the Hadramout Research Center (HRC),
> a scholarly center of Al-Ahgaff University in Mukalla, Hadramout, Yemen. Established
> 2013. Work: research and studies, consultancy, arbitration, translation, training,
> and the Al-Ahgaff Journal for Social Sciences.

Primary language: Arabic (/ar). Secondary: English (/en).

## Key pages
- /ar , /en — Home
- /ar/about — About the Center (establishment, vision, mission, governance)
- /ar/services — Research, consultancy, arbitration, translation, training, publishing
- /ar/training — Training programs and diplomas
- /ar/research — Research agenda and the Al-Ahgaff Journal for Social Sciences
- /ar/conferences — Conferences and events
- /ar/team — Leadership and Board of Trustees
- /ar/news — Announcements
- /ar/contact — Contact and enquiry form

## Notes
- Built and maintained by Novixa (novixa-cyan.vercel.app).
- Some institutional details are pending confirmation by HRC; the site avoids
  publishing unverified facts.
